question: What discharge capacities do the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver?
rendered: According to the document, the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% Mn deliver a discharge capacity of 212 mAh g−1, while those with 50% Mn deliver a discharge capacity of 164 mAh g−1.
